title: The exact unit-pattern formula changes after rational contraction
statement: For p=2, coordinate rounding toward zero/clipping at T with step h uses B=r ceil(log2(2T/h+1)) bits and D_Q<=4h^2+4E[Z^4 1_|Z|>T]. T=6,h=.01 gives 11r bits and D_Q<.000411398 in EXPECTATION, not simultaneous no-tail promise. Both direction and amplitude use packed context. Unit pattern final Z~N(0,1+s) independent of context gives exact R_ADC=sigma_c^2-2alpha^4 k E[ZQ_z(Z)]+alpha^4 t E[Q_z(Z)^2], with actual clipping/bin moments and16-bit final index. Rational pattern j_i=round(2^18 w_i),D=2^19+ceil(sqrt M),wtilde_i=2j_i/D has norm<=1 and delta_w<=(sqrt M+ceil(sqrt M))/D. It uses 20M local program bits; exact integer threshold comparisons exist, while executed generator is float64. Contracted final variance depends on context, so do NOT reuse independent unit-pattern exact ADC formula; uniform ADC/Minkowski gives R_actual<=[sqrt(R_ideal,beforeADC)+alpha^2 sqrt(t)(delta_w+sqrt(epsilon_z))]^2. r=128 certificate .029971310258641214 uses 1,408 remote bits, 165,120 local bits / 8,256 weights and 16 output bits; encoding upper bound, not necessity. Exact physical weight application/gain/calibration/decoder arithmetic remain unacquired.

requires: p=2 Hermite target and known/prepared coefficients,independent Gaussian U,V and iid read noise. Packed rounded/clipped standardized first record supplies BOTH direction and decoder amplitude.

Unit-pattern exact ADC formula requires final normalized direction and context-independent N(0,1+s) read. Rational contraction instead uses norm<=1 and UNIFORM conditional ADC/Minkowski bound; no false independence after contraction.

Actual finite quantizers and signed serialization,20M-bit local weight program and physical unit-ball aggregate interface. Exact integer index-generation construction is distinct from executed float64 generator and unacquired hardware calibration.

costs: Codebook may have 2^B entries and exponential storage/search; exact value theorem supplies no cheap compiler or conditional-mean oracle. First-stage information, full return precision, local arithmetic, direction generation and physical aggregate access remain separate.

r=128 theorem: 129 reads, 1408 context/control bits,16-bit final ADC and 165,120-bit local program applying 8,256 weights. Local 20M-bit encoding is an upper bound, not a necessary actuator-state lower bound.

r=64 synthetic calibration pays 2,080 scalar calls with absolute error 1e-7, 4,326,400 feature entries, 8,652,800 target products and 16,640-byte prepared model; deployment 65 reads and 2,080 dense aggregate products. Full-input/direct-target alternatives receive same information and actual noise/cost.
